subject: science
passage: Asiatic lions once roamed across much of western and southern Asia, but by the early 1900s hunting had reduced them to a small group in the Gir Forest of Gujarat, India. Since then, strict protection of the forest has allowed the population to ______. An official count found about 180 lions in 1968, and by 2020 the number had grown to more than 670.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

explanation.why: After hunting had left only "a small group," protection allowed the numbers to rise from about 180 to more than 670. A population that grows back after falling very low is recovering, so "recover" fits.
explanation.A: Incorrect. The lions did not disappear; the count rose to more than 670.
explanation.B: Incorrect. The text says the lions survive in the Gir Forest and gives no sign that they moved somewhere else.
explanation.C: Correct. Protection let a population that hunting had cut to "a small group" grow back to more than 670, so it was able to recover.
explanation.D: Incorrect. The count went up from about 180 to more than 670, so the population grew rather than declined.
